events.body: DL-7791 was attempted 2027-03-22 at 15:42, no answer, card left. Redelivery inventory: 2027-03-24 or 2027-03-26, both 12:00–18:00 UTC. No charge for one redelivery.
Missed the driver yesterday by about ten minutes. Friday please.
Aurelio has chosen redelivery on 2027-03-26, 12:00–18:00 for DL-7791. Please book and confirm.
DL-7791 is booked for redelivery 2027-03-26, 12:00–18:00 and allocated to Friday run R-27C. Booking confirmation, not a delivery.
Dispatch confirms DL-7791 is booked for redelivery on Friday 2027-03-26 between 12:00 and 18:00.
Change of plan, work want me in on Friday now. I drive past your depot on the way home, can I just pick it up from there instead? Thursday after 5 would suit. Cancel the Friday one.
Recipient of DL-7791 asks to collect from your counter instead of Friday redelivery, ideally Thursday 2027-03-25 after 17:00. Can you hold it for collection, and what does he need to bring?

Counter is open to 19:00 weekdays and we hold for 5 working days. But DL-7791 is allocated to run R-27C and sits in the Friday cage. We cannot move it to the collection shelf until Dispatch releases it from the run. Once it is released and shelved we issue a collection reference; nobody collects without that reference. Photo ID matching the order name at the counter.

Collection from the depot counter is possible but not arranged yet. The parcel is still allocated to Friday's delivery run and Dispatch has to release it first; the depot then issues a collection reference, and nobody can collect without one. Please don't travel until I send you that reference. Shall I go ahead, knowing the Friday redelivery will be removed?
Yes go ahead. Definitely not Friday, nobody will be in. Thursday after 5 if they can.
